# A Biblioteca Antigolpe

> Catálogo pesquisável para evitar golpes, fraudes e scams: tipos de golpe, apostas e jogos de azar, ferramentas para verificar sites, perfis e investimentos, onde denunciar, guias oficiais, proteção digital, livros, documentários e quem desmascara golpes.

Biblioteca temática da BiblioVerse (The Anti-Scam Library), com curadoria humana. Página: https://biblioverse.org/antiscam/ · 334 itens · atualizada em 2026-11-14.
Legenda: ★ destaque da curadoria · 🪦 pessoa falecida, banda desfeita ou serviço encerrado.

## Conceitos fundamentais

### Tipos de golpe

- [Golpe (conto do vigário)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Confidence_trick) ★
- [Phishing](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Phishing) ★
- [Smishing (golpe por SMS)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/SMS_phishing)
- [Vishing (golpe por ligação)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Voice_phishing)
- [Spear phishing](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spear_phishing)
- [Golpe do amor (romance scam)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Romance_scam) ★
- [Pig butchering](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pig_butchering_scam)
- [Catfishing](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Catfishing)
- [Sextorsão](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sextortion)
- [Golpe do falso suporte técnico](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Technical_support_scam)
- [Golpe do adiantamento (419)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Advance-fee_scam)
- [Golpe do falso emprego](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Employment_scam)
- [Golpe do falso sequestro](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Virtual_kidnapping)
- [Golpe da loteria](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lottery_scam)
- [Falsa caridade](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Charity_fraud)
- [Fraude de cartão de crédito](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Credit_card_fraud)
- [Troca de SIM (SIM swap)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/SIM_swap_scam)
- [Roubo de identidade](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Identity_theft) ★
- [Deepfake](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Deepfake)
- [Clonagem de voz (deepfake de áudio)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Audio_deepfake)
- [Ransomware](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ransomware)
- [Scareware](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Scareware)
- [Golpe de entrega fantasma (brushing)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brushing_(e-commerce))
- [Golpe do pagamento em excesso](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Overpayment_scam)
- [Fraude de seguro](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Insurance_fraud)
- [Falso antivírus (rogue security software)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rogue_security_software)
- [Lista de golpes (Wikipédia)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_scams) ★

### Golpes financeiros e de investimento

- [Pirâmide financeira](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pyramid_scheme) ★
- [Esquema Ponzi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ponzi_scheme) ★
- [Marketing multinível](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Multi-level_marketing)
- [Pump and dump](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pump_and_dump)
- [Rug pull (golpe de saída)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Exit_scam)
- [Golpes com criptomoedas](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cryptocurrency_and_crime)
- [Fraude de investimento](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Securities_fraud)

### Técnicas dos golpistas

- [Engenharia social](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Social_engineering_(security)) ★
- [Pretexting](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pretexting)
- [Falsificação de identificador de chamada](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Caller_ID_spoofing)
- [Falsificação de e-mail (spoofing)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Email_spoofing)
- [Typosquatting](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Typosquatting)
- [Ataque homográfico](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IDN_homograph_attack)
- [Pharming](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pharming)
- [Conta laranja (money mule)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Money_mule)

### Proteção e prevenção

- [Autenticação multifator](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Multi-factor_authentication) ★
- [Gerenciador de senhas](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Password_manager)
- [Força de senha](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Password_strength)
- [Antivírus](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Antivirus_software)
- [Chargeback (contestação)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chargeback)
- [Congelamento de crédito](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Credit_freeze)
- [Conheça seu cliente (KYC)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Know_your_customer)
- [Pagamento com garantia (escrow)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Escrow)

## Apostas e jogos de azar

### Conceitos de apostas

- [Jogo de azar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gambling) ★
- [Cassino online](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Online_gambling) ★
- [Apostas esportivas (bets)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sports_betting) ★
- [Casa de apostas](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bookmaker)
- [Loteria](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lottery)
- [Opções binárias](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Binary_option) ★
- [Fortune Tiger (jogo do tigrinho)](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fortune_Tiger) ★
- [Loot box (caixa de recompensa)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Loot_box)
- [Manipulação de resultados](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Match_fixing)
- [Vantagem da casa](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Casino_game)
- [Falácia do apostador](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gambler%27s_fallacy)
- [Valor esperado](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Expected_value)
- [Jogo patológico (vício em apostas)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Problem_gambling) ★
- [Polymarket (mercado de previsões)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Polymarket)

- [Cloudflare 1.1.1.1 for Families](https://one.one.one.one/family/)
